```sql
WITH lines AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT pv.product_id,
           o.id  AS order_id,
           pv.id AS variant_id,
           ol.quantity,
           ol.line_total_cents
      FROM orders o
      JOIN order_lines ol      ON ol.order_id = o.id
      JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
     WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
       AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
),
per_order AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           count(*)            AS order_count,
           sum(q)::bigint      AS quantity,
           sum(r)              AS revenue_cents
      FROM (
            SELECT product_id, order_id,
                   sum(quantity)         AS q,
                   sum(line_total_cents) AS r
              FROM lines
             GROUP BY product_id, order_id
           ) x
     GROUP BY product_id
),
per_variant AS (
    SELECT product_id, count(*) AS variant_count
      FROM (SELECT product_id, variant_id FROM lines GROUP BY product_id, variant_id) y
     GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       po.order_count,
       po.quantity,
       po.revenue_cents,
       pvc.variant_count
  FROM per_order po
  JOIN per_variant pvc ON pvc.product_id = po.product_id
  JOIN products p      ON p.id = po.product_id
 ORDER BY po.quantity DESC, po.revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De dure sortering op (p.id, o.id) voor `count(DISTINCT)` (spill naar schijf) is vervangen door hash-aggregaties: eerst per product/order en per product/variant, daarna per product. De `products`-join gebeurt pas op de reeds geaggregeerde rijen. Kolomnamen, types (`quantity` blijft bigint via cast) en ORDER BY zijn ongewijzigd.
